name: Voxel Water Refraction and Transmission
definition: A three-phase rendering technique for water: Phase 1 marches from the camera to the first non-air/water cell to find the entry point. Phase 2 calculates the surface reflection and refracts the ray into the water. Phase 3 marches the refracted ray through the water volume to find the exit point or background, applying Beer-Lambert attenuation.
summary: Voxel Water Refraction and Transmission is a deterministic ray-marching technique for simulating light interaction with voxel-based water, distinct from full volumetric path tracing by using Restartable DDA for efficient voxel grid traversal.
